title: Binance Adds ALICE/BNB, ATOM/TRY, ETH/UST, GALA/AUD, LRC/BNB, ONE/ETH & OOKI/BNB Trading Pairs
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will open trading for ALICE/BNB, ATOM/TRY, ETH/UST, GALA/AUD, LRC/BNB, ONE/ETH and OOKI/BNB trading pairs at 2022-01-07 09:00 AM (UTC). Please note: AUD and TRY are fiat currencies and do not represent any other digital currencies. Risk warning : Cryptocurrency trading is subject to high market risk.
